q: Monotone circuit complexity: a monotone Boolean circuit uses only AND and OR gates (no negation). Razborov (1985) proved exponential lower bounds on monotone circuit size for:
opts: The CLIQUE function: detecting if a graph on n vertices has a k-clique requires monotone circuits of size exp(Ω(n^{1/4}))
All functions with more than n/2 satisfying inputs
exp: Razborov's breakthrough (1985): the clique function CLIQUE_{n,k} (k = n^{1/3}) requires monotone circuit size exp(Ω(n^{1/4})). This used the approximation method (sunflower lemma). The result was strengthened by Alon-Boppana and later Rossman (2008) to size n^{Ω(k)} for k-clique.
